newsitem.title: IRAQ: Iraq condemns Iran for hosting Kurdish meeting.
newsitem.headline: Iraq condemns Iran for hosting Kurdish meeting.

text.p: Iraq on Tuesday condemned Iran for hosting a meeting to mediate between two warring Iraqi Kurdish factions.

A statement by a Foreign Ministry spokesman, quoted by the official Iraqi News Agency, said: "Iraq strongly denounces such hostile practices (and) asks the Iranian government to end its vicious acts (against Iraq)."
The spokesman said Iran was "interfering in Iraq's internal affairs in order to implement a vicious policy against Iraq's security and its people's stability".
Representatives of the Patriotic Union of Kurdistan and the Kurdistan Islamic Movement met in Iran last week to discuss ending clashes which broke out in April in Halabja area in northern Iraq.
Kurdish rebels have been in control of northern Iraq since the 1991 Gulf War which ejected Iraqi troops out of Kuwait.
Iraq and Iran fought a war from 1980 to 1988.
